fairness_notes.failed_rows_reason: The original 4096-token long rows cannot run honestly on TinyLlama-1.1B with vLLM max_model_len=2048; the first repaired long/mixed/chat rerun still produced HTTP 400 rows after TinyLlama chat-template tokenization exceeded 2048. Successful matched rows from this artifact are short_short and short_long at c1/c16.

metric_notes.ttft: Measured from request send to first streamed assistant token chunk.
metric_notes.inter_token_latency: Measured as gaps between streamed assistant token chunk arrivals.
metric_notes.gpu: Valid only when gpu_metrics_valid is true; otherwise CSV GPU columns are zeros from missing samples.
